newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Hotel workers may strike at Lisbon OSCE summit.
newsitem.headline: Hotel workers may strike at Lisbon OSCE summit.

text.p: Workers at four luxury hotels are preparing a possible strike that would disrupt a summit of the Organisation for Cooperation and Security in Europe (OSCE) next month, a union official said on Wednesday.

"In principle we are preparing to strike on December 2 to press demands for higher salaries in 1997 and a reduction in the hours worked in a week," Rodolfo Caseiro, head of the 20,000-strong Hotel Workers' Union, told Reuters.

He said the one-day strike, which would coincide with the OSCE summit on December 2-3, would affect up to 800 workers at the Ritz, Sheraton, Tivoli and Penta hotels in Lisbon where many world leaders were expected to stay.

Waiters, receptionists and maintenance staff would vote whether to strike or stage other types of protests at plenary meetings to be held at the hotels on November 25 and 26, Caseiro said. Hotel managements had rejected the union's demands.
The summit will include leaders from 52 countries in Europe, North America and the former Soviet Union.
